name: Trick or Treat
source:
Welcome to the harvest festival of blood and assault... On 30 October 201X.
A teacher who was fired due to his misconduct summoned his students and colleagues to an old building of the academy that is no longer used.
His idea was simple: confine them in the building using a master key, then humiliate them.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE141948.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到鲜血与袭击的丰收节……201X年10月30日。
一名因行为不当而被解雇的老师将他的学生和同事召集到学院一栋不再使用的老建筑里。
他的想法很简单：使用万能钥匙将他们限制在建筑物内，然后羞辱他们。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE141948.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
